Stranded in the Sirius Sector, the Detachments settled a number of worlds which they have adapted to their unique needs. The Detachments changed over time as well, becoming more distinct and developing their own ideas of how best to serve their Founder. Now, Detachments struggle to maintain a sense of unity and purpose as they become more distinct. Following the genetic innovations of the Founder, the Battle Brothers were soon deployed to maintain unity and peace over Earth and its nearby colonies. [Read more lore on our website](https://www.onepagerules.com/factions/battle-brothers) ### Army-Wide Special Rules Wolfborn: When this unit is activated, you may place all models with this rule in it anywhere fully within D3" of their position. ### Special Rules Fortified: When units where all models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0). Lacerate: When attacking the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6. Mend: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it. Re-Deployment: After all other units are deployed (excluding units that were set aside), you may remove up to two friendly units from the table and deploy them again. Players alternate in placing Re-Deployment units, starting with the player that activates next. Re-Position Artillery: Once per activation, pick one friendly model within 6" with Artillery, which may immediately move by up to 9". Shielded: Units where all models have this rule get +1 to defense rolls against hits that are not from spells. Unstoppable Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unstoppable against once (next time the effect would apply). Versatile Attack: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting or charging enemies over 9" away, all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls. ### Aura Special Rules Bane in Melee Aura: This model and its unit get Bane in melee. Bane when Shooting Aura: This model and its unit get Bane when shooting. Counter-Attack Aura: This model and its unit get Counter-Attack. Courage Aura: This model and its unit get +1 to morale test rolls. Melee Shrouding Aura: This model and its unit get Melee Shrouding. Rapid Rush Aura: This model and its unit get Rapid Rush. Regeneration Aura: This model and its unit get Regeneration. Versatile Reach Aura: This model and its unit get Versatile Reach. Read more ### Spells Wolf Sight (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which friendly units gets Unstoppable when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply). Wolf Trauma (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which takes 1 hit with Blast(3) and Lacerate. Righteous Fury (2): Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Piercing Assault once (next time the effect would apply). Godly Thunder (2): Pick one enemy model within 24", which takes 2 hits with AP(4). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1]. Wolf Dome (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Evasive once (next time the effect would apply). Storm of Power (3): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 6 hits with AP(1) and Surge. Roll as many dice as hits to see if "on rolls of 6" effects trigger. ### Units ### Heroes Wolf Master Destroyer [1] Qua 3+Def 3+ 155pts CCW(A4) Ambush, Fearless, Hero, Shielded, Tough(6), Wolfborn
